architectural_units.name: Frontend
architectural_units.description: The mobile application developed with Flutter, which acts as the presentation layer.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server-side software responsible for processing user requests, implemented using Django.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer
architectural_units.description: Contains the purest business logic of the system, as well as domain models and repository interfaces.

architectural_units.name: Application Layer
architectural_units.description: Includes the system's use cases, which orchestrate business logic and define the flow of operations.

architectural_units.name: Infrastructure Layer
architectural_units.description: Responsible for interaction with the outside, including Django HTTP views, repositories, and adapters for external services.

architectural_units.name: Cubit
architectural_units.description: A pattern used for state management and business logic in the Flutter frontend.

architectural_units.name: Authentication Service
architectural_units.description: Specialized service responsible for creating and sending OTP codes for delegated login.

architectural_units.name: AI Service
architectural_units.description: External service used for generating response suggestions for reviews.

architectural_units.name: Flutter
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the development of the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Django
architectural_units.description: Framework used for the construction of the REST API in the backend.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used for data persistence.

architectural_units.name: Gemini
architectural_units.description: External AI service integrated into the system.

architectural_units.name: ChatGPT
architectural_units.description: External AI service integrated into the system.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol used between frontend and backend.
La comunicació entre el front-end i el back-end es realitza mitjançant una API REST, utilitzant missatges en format JSON tant per a les peticions com per a les respostes.

El back-end està implementat utilitzant Django i segueix el patró d’Arquitectura Hexagonal [...] Dins del back-end es poden distingir clarament tres capes principals: Capa de Domini [...] Capa d’Aplicació [...] Capa d’Infraestructura.
La persistència de les dades es realitza mitjançant una base de dades relacional MySQL, gestionada a través de l’ORM de Django.
El sistema integra diversos serveis externs a través del back-end, com ara serveis d’intel·ligència artificial (Gemini o ChatGPT) i serveis d’autenticació.

architectural_units.name: REST
architectural_units.description: La comunicació entre el front-end i el back-end es realitza mitjançant una API REST

architectural_units.name: JSON
architectural_units.description: Les dades s’intercanvien en format JSON, utilitzant mètodes HTTP estàndard com GET i POST.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The system follows a client-server architecture where the mobile application acts as the frontend and the server processes requests.

patterns.name: Hexagonal Architecture
patterns.description: The backend follows the Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters) pattern, which allows separating business logic from the framework and infrastructure technologies.

patterns.name: Repository Pattern
patterns.description: Isolates data access and simplifies the use of the ORM in use cases.

patterns.name: Factory Pattern
patterns.description: Used to dynamically instantiate artificial intelligence services according to the system configuration.

patterns.name: Clean Architecture
patterns.description: The frontend follows the principles of Clean Architecture, applied strictly to organize code into layers.
